$comment: Verif-Kit per-project config. Copy to repo root as verif-kit.config.json and edit. This is the ONE place project specifics live, so the agent/skill prompts stay generic and portable (mirrors spec-kit's init-options.json). All paths are repo-root-relative.

framework.frameworkDir: node_modules-or-vendored path to verif-kit framework (scoreboard, coverage-model)

commands.$comment: How to run things in THIS repo. The agent/skill call these instead of hard-coding. On Windows where the toolchain is not on the non-interactive PATH, prefix accordingly.
commands.$comment_e2eEngines: Browser engines to run the critical E2E path on. Include 'webkit' to approximate iOS Safari (catches Safari-only quirks). List only engines your project actually has installed; drop to ['chromium'] if that's all you run.

staging.$comment: The right-sized STAGED GATE — depth is earned by risk + evidence, not spent by default. Total verification time should target ~1x the module's design time (NOT 10x). See docs/methodology.md §9 and the agent charter §'Right-sized execution'.

stage1.$comment: Cheap, minutes; ALWAYS run for non-chrome tiers; the bug-finding stage. Independent plan + ambiguity sweep, then a small high-leverage targeted set: boundary + equivalence partitions + metamorphic/conservation + 2-3 hand-computed goldens + hazard-class adversarial probes. No reference-model volume, no mutation.

stage1Gate.$comment: Escalate to Stage 2 ONLY if at least one trigger holds; otherwise sign off at Stage 1 (a real sign-off).

stage2.$comment: Expensive, GATED, time-boxed, Critical-mostly. Reference model + scoreboard + BOUNDED random (grow N to coverage closure then stop) + security/runtime lenses + INCREMENTAL SAMPLED mutation on critical functions only.
stage2.boundedRandom: grow until functional coverage closes, then stop — no fixed huge N

mutation.policy: incremental + sampled; accept a small live-mutant budget (classify survivors equivalent-vs-real); it measures regression-suite strength, not product bugs

riskTiers.$comment: Per-tier gates. `defaultStage` is where a clean run signs off; Stage 2 still triggers on a found bug regardless. mutationFloor/coverage floors apply ONLY at a Stage-2 sign-off — a Stage-1 sign-off does not run mutation.

security.$comment: Enable the cyber-engineer lens for modules touching auth, multi-user data, or untrusted input.

onlineResearch.$comment: Allow the verifier to research DOMAIN corner cases online. It must NEVER search for or read the implementation under test.
onlineResearch.scope: domain edge cases, standards, known-tricky inputs — never the implementation

independence.$comment: b = in-session fresh subagent (default); c = separate cloud session (strongest, reserve for P0/evidence).
